description: This file defines an immutable class representing a JSON boolean value, including singleton instances for true and false, and methods for accessing, comparing, and serializing the value.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonBoolean
classes.description: An immutable class representing a JSON boolean value, providing singleton instances for true and false, and methods for value access, equality, and serialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an ImmutableJsonBoolean instance with the specified boolean value.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Indicates that this JSON value is a boolean.

methods.name: asBoolean
methods.description: Returns the boolean value represented by this instance.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the boolean value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the boolean value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation ('true' or 'false') of the boolean value.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the boolean value using the provided serialization context.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum string size when serialized ('true' or 'false').
